messages:
deploy-bot: START ROLLOUT v2.17.3 -> US/EU/APAC
deploy-bot: staged rollout initiated: canary 5% US only, then 20% across US, EU, APAC. pin fallback: v2.17.2. change-window 02:00-06:00 UTC

sam: quick capacity numbers pls — canary CPU/GPU headroom in each region?

lina: US pool reported warm GPUs: 48/50 available, current concurrent rps ~4200, target headroom 10% => ok for 5% canary

miguel: EU warm GPUs 22/30, current rps ~1900, headroom borderline 5% — recommend holding EU canary until warm pool +2

ops-sre: APAC warm GPUs 12/20, rps 1600, thermal throttle risk at +15% traffic

sam: propose sequence: 1) US 5% canary now, 2) monitor 15m, if stable -> US 25% + EU 5% (only if EU pool bumped), 3) APAC only after US+EU stable

irene: adding rollback criteria: latency p95 +30% vs baseline OR error rate >1.5% for 3m -> immediate pin to v2.17.2

deploy-bot: CANARY STARTED: us-canary-1 -> commit: a0b3c4 v2.17.3
deploy-bot: canary metrics stream: https://deploy.metrics/redwood/rollouts/4307771234

sam: seeing small 6% p95 increase on embeddings route but error rate 0.2% — keeping watch

lina: bumped EU warm pool by +4 (manual warm-up) ETA 12m

miguel: APAC thermal alert suppressed after warmup script, still prefer delayed ramp

ops-sre: adding guardrail: if token cost per minute increases >20% -> throttle rollout

sam: ok go ahead with US->25%, EU->5% in 30m if no alerts. APAC wait for warm pool confirmation

deploy-bot: RAMP: us 25% deployed, eu 5% scheduled in 28m
deploy-bot: logs: us-canary-1: alloc 5/50 GPUs, p95 latency +8% (below threshold), errors 0.4%

irene: confirm fallback job ready: rollback job queued to pin v2.17.2 across regions, manual approve required

sam: manual approve given

ops-sre: leaving runbook link: /runbooks/geo-rollout-fallback

miguel: will watch APAC warm pool and advise for next window

lina: EU metrics green after warm pool +4

deploy-bot: eu-canary-start: eu-canary-1 alloc 3/30 GPUs
deploy-bot: SCHEDULE: apac-ramp pending, will only start after explicit signal

sam: thumbs up — keep the thread updated. :thumbsup:

ops-sre: note: change-window ends 06:00 UTC, if APAC not green we push APAC to next window

deploy-bot: THREAD NOTE: if rollback triggered, pinned rollback will run in 90s automated with canary drain

sam: thanks team, will reconvene if any alerts.
